articles.title: Michigan Primary Tests Democratic Party's Soul — and Senate Control
articles.summary: Today's Michigan primary pits progressive Abdul El-Sayed against establishment-backed Haley Stevens in a race that could tip the Senate. With millions in outside spending and a bitter Gaza-war rift, the outcome will signal the party's direction — and its chances against Republican Mike Rogers in November.

articles.title: The 'Health Halo' Hustle: Why Your Avocado Oil Might Be a Cheap Imposter
articles.summary: A UC Davis study found 89% of avocado-oil products tested were adulterated with cheaper oils, exposing a widespread 'healthwashing' tactic. Companies use buzzwords and clever packaging to exploit our cognitive biases — and charge premium prices. Here's the economics behind the deception and how to outsmart it.

articles.title: Record Heatwave Kills Three Lions in Tokyo as East Asia Swelters
articles.summary: Three lionesses at Tokyo's Tama Zoo died of suspected heatstroke amid a brutal East Asian heatwave. South Korea declared a national disaster after 19 deaths and a record 42.5°C. With climate change and a strengthening El Niño, scientists warn extreme heat is becoming the new normal — even for animals evolved for Africa.
